settings.title: Who it’s for
settings.text:
Made for adults in their 40s, 50s and 60s. Most of our customers are in their 40s and 50s. You don’t need to be sporty or own a smartwatch.

It’s for you if afternoons feel harder than they used to, you get less back from the same effort, or you want to keep up with work, family and the things you love.

settings.title: What it does
settings.text:
Five jobs in one daily formula:

  • Energy. Vitamins B6 and B12 contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue.
  • Recovery. Vitamin D contributes to normal muscle function.
  • Stress. B vitamins contribute to normal psychological function, and B5 to normal mental performance.
  • Longevity. 300mg NR, which your body turns into NAD+, plus zinc, which contributes to the protection of cells from oxidative stress.
  • Immunity. Vitamin D, zinc, copper, folate, B6 and B12 contribute to the normal function of the immune system.

One jar instead of five pots: no separate NAD+, CoQ10, resveratrol, D3 + K2 or B-complex.

settings.title: What’s inside
settings.text:
19 ingredients in two capsules. Every dose is on the label, per two-capsule serving:

  • TMG (trimethylglycine) 450mg
  • NR (nicotinamide riboside) 300mg
  • Grape seed extract 150mg · 120:1 extract, 95% polyphenols, 142.5mg
  • CoQ10 150mg · ubiquinone
  • Zinc 15mg · zinc bisglycinate
  • Trans-resveratrol 50mg · from Japanese knotweed root, 95%
  • Vitamin D3 50mcg (2,000 IU) · cholecalciferol, from algae
  • PQQ 20mg · pyrroloquinoline quinone
  • Vitamin B3 16mg · nicotinamide, no flush
  • Vitamin B12 100mcg · methylcobalamin
  • Vitamin B5 10mg · calcium D-pantothenate
  • Copper 1mg · copper bisglycinate
  • Vitamin K2 100mcg · menaquinone-7, MK-7
  • Vitamin B6 5mg · pyridoxal-5′-phosphate, P5P
  • Vitamin B2 5mg · riboflavin-5′-phosphate
  • Vitamin B1 5mg · thiamine hydrochloride
  • BioPerine® black pepper extract 5mg · 95% piperine, 4.75mg
  • Folate 400mcg · L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate, 5-MTHF
  • Biotin 300mcg · D-biotin

Filter them by job on our ingredients page.

settings.title: How to take it
settings.text:
Two capsules every morning with breakfast.

Why with food? CoQ10, vitamin D3 and K2 dissolve in fat, so your body takes them in best with a meal.

Why every day? It works best as a habit. Keep the jar by the kettle.

settings.title: Quality and testing
settings.text:
• Every dose on the label, no proprietary blends
  • Only UK-authorised ingredients: that’s why we use NR, not NMN
  • Made in the UK to GMP standards
  • Every batch tested before release for heavy metals, microbes and capsule quality
  • Vegan capsules from plant cellulose, vitamin D3 from algae, no major allergens

settings.title: Who it’s for
settings.text:
Made for adults in their 40s, 50s and 60s. Most of our customers are in their 40s and 50s. You don’t need to be sporty or own a smartwatch.

It’s for you if afternoons feel harder than they used to, you get less back from the same effort, or you want to keep up with work, family and the things you love.

settings.title: What it does
settings.text:
Five jobs in one daily formula:

  • Energy. Vitamins B6 and B12 contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue.
  • Recovery. Vitamin D contributes to normal muscle function.
  • Stress. B vitamins contribute to normal psychological function, and B5 to normal mental performance.
  • Longevity. 300mg NR, which your body turns into NAD+, plus zinc, which contributes to the protection of cells from oxidative stress.
  • Immunity. Vitamin D, zinc, copper, folate, B6 and B12 contribute to the normal function of the immune system.

One jar instead of five pots: no separate NAD+, CoQ10, resveratrol, D3 + K2 or B-complex.

settings.title: What’s inside
settings.text:
19 ingredients in two capsules. Every dose is on the label, per two-capsule serving:

  • TMG (trimethylglycine) 450mg
  • NR (nicotinamide riboside) 300mg
  • Grape seed extract 150mg · 120:1 extract, 95% polyphenols, 142.5mg
  • CoQ10 150mg · ubiquinone
  • Zinc 15mg · zinc bisglycinate
  • Trans-resveratrol 50mg · from Japanese knotweed root, 95%
  • Vitamin D3 50mcg (2,000 IU) · cholecalciferol, from algae
  • PQQ 20mg · pyrroloquinoline quinone
  • Vitamin B3 16mg · nicotinamide, no flush
  • Vitamin B12 100mcg · methylcobalamin
  • Vitamin B5 10mg · calcium D-pantothenate
  • Copper 1mg · copper bisglycinate
  • Vitamin K2 100mcg · menaquinone-7, MK-7
  • Vitamin B6 5mg · pyridoxal-5′-phosphate, P5P
  • Vitamin B2 5mg · riboflavin-5′-phosphate
  • Vitamin B1 5mg · thiamine hydrochloride
  • BioPerine® black pepper extract 5mg · 95% piperine, 4.75mg
  • Folate 400mcg · L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate, 5-MTHF
  • Biotin 300mcg · D-biotin

Filter them by job on our ingredients page.

settings.title: How to take it
settings.text:
Two capsules every morning with breakfast.

Why with food? CoQ10, vitamin D3 and K2 dissolve in fat, so your body takes them in best with a meal.

Why every day? It works best as a habit. Keep the jar by the kettle.

settings.title: Quality and testing
settings.text:
• Every dose on the label, no proprietary blends
  • Only UK-authorised ingredients: that’s why we use NR, not NMN
  • Made in the UK to GMP standards
  • Every batch tested before release for heavy metals, microbes and capsule quality
  • Vegan capsules from plant cellulose, vitamin D3 from algae, no major allergens
